# Code of conduct

xGEO follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful, assume good faith, criticise ideas and not people,
and keep discussion about the project. Harassment, personal attacks and
discrimination are not tolerated in issues, pull requests or any project
space.

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to the maintainer through GitHub
(the contact on the maintainer's profile). Reports are kept confidential.
The maintainer may remove comments, close threads or block anyone who breaks
these rules.
